title: Deprecate and remove memorysmith_semantic_search and memorysmith_unified_search
description: Remove two redundant search tools from the chat tool catalog to reduce surface-area confusion in the trained model. semantic_search is always redundant (hybrid_search fuses lexical+semantic). unified_search overlaps with hybrid_search + page_search. Reduce chat tools from 12 to 10, update prompt routing, regenerate training data, retrain LoRA adapter.

steps.title: Update prompt files (wiki-chat-agent.md + .modelfile)
steps.description: Remove semantic_search and unified_search from routing heuristics. Add clear rule: 'Use memorysmith_hybrid_search as the default memory search for all wiki questions.' Remove from 'Supported intercepted tools' list. Update modelfile to match.
steps.acceptance: Prompt lists only 10 read-only tools, routing says hybrid is default

steps.title: Remove tool registrations from ChatToolCatalog.cs
steps.description: Delete the yield return blocks for memorysmith_semantic_search and memorysmith_unified_search. These are ~100 lines total. No other tool depends on these.
steps.acceptance: Build succeeds after removal, no orphaned references

steps.title: Verify MCP controller delegation
steps.description: McpController.cs delegates to the catalog via _toolCatalog.TryGet(). Confirm no direct tool name references for the deprecated tools. If any exist, remove them.
steps.acceptance: MCP controller compiles without references to deprecated tool names

steps.title: Update README.md
steps.description: Remove semantic_search and unified_search from the chat tool allowlist. Update routing documentation if it references these tools.

steps.title: Update ChatToolCatalogAndInterceptTests.cs
steps.description: Remove test expectations that reference memorysmith_semantic_search and memorysmith_unified_search. Key areas: intent interception test cases, tool count assertions, tool name lists.
steps.acceptance: All tests pass, no references to deprecated tools

steps.title: Update McpAndSemanticSearchTests.cs
steps.description: Remove test cases that exercise semantic_search and unified_search via MCP. Keep hybrid_search and lexical search tests.

steps.title: Update .continue/rules/memory-smith.md
steps.description: Remove semantic_search and unified_search from the Continue agent tool-usage rules.

steps.title: Regenerate SFT training corpus
steps.description: Create new training data exports that exclude semantic_search and unified_search examples. Add new routing examples that teach hybrid_search as the default for general wiki queries.
steps.acceptance: Corpus contains 0 references to deprecated tools, hybrid_search is the dominant search tool

steps.title: Update spotcheck eval cases
steps.description: Replace the 5 semantic_search and 5 unified_search cases in the spotcheck eval with 5 hybrid_search and 5 search cases.
steps.acceptance: Spotcheck eval covers all remaining tool families

steps.title: Run full validation
steps.description: Scripts/Validate-Repo.ps1 -IncludeDocs: build, all tests, task/memory/page validation. Fix any regressions.

steps.title: Retrain LoRA adapter
steps.description: Train new adapter with the consolidated corpus. Target: 3 epochs, 500 max steps, batch=2, QLoRA. Compare tool-match against spotcheck baseline.
steps.acceptance: Tool-match on new eval >= 60% (baseline was 50% with 4 tools)

steps.title: Deploy adapter to Ollama and browser-validate /chat
steps.description: Create new memorysmith-athena:latest with updated adapter. Test in browser.
steps.acceptance: Chat uses hybrid_search as default, search for exact terms, page_search for pages

notes: semantic_search always scores worse than hybrid_search in spotcheck (2/5 vs 0/5). unified_search scores 0/5 because the model treats 'search the wiki' as memorysmith_search. Removing both eliminates the two worst-performing tools and simplifies prompt routing. No renames — keep memorysmith_search and memorysmith_hybrid_search stable for MCP clients.
